entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Check out the pictures I took[n]today!
entries.uk: Гляньте на фото, які я зробила[n]сьогодні!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The steam fogged up his glasses...[n]Another of the many charms of[n]eating hot pot, I suppose.
entries.uk: Пара затуманила йому окуляри...[n]Ще одна з багатьох принад[n]їжі з казанка, мабуть.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh man... I keep looking back at[n]this picture, and [fName]'s[n]face is STILL hilarious...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh yeah—Yusuke is still at[n][fName]'s place, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't go making any trouble[n]for him, okay?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Of course. I'd like to think I'm[n]not THAT socially graceless.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: All I can ask is a warm futon and[n]a traditional Japanese breakfast.
entries.uk: Усе, чого я прошу, — теплий футон[n]і традиційний японський сніданок.
